verification: CP28 is a typography clarity hotfix on top of CP27. Across the app, text that inherits the Inter/system UI sans stack is increased by 0.5px where an explicit px font-size is defined, while Georgia/serif display typography and icon-like glyph rules are preserved. The global sans body gains a slightly stronger inherited weight (450) and font optical sizing for clearer rendering. The approved visual hierarchy, colors, imagery, routing, SSO, learning-sync, Admin/Mod behavior, and application architecture are unchanged. CI, Cloudflare deployment and production smoke remain mandatory.
